text: {"observations":"Broadband noise swells recur roughly every 7-8 s (peaks near 0-1.5 s, 7-9 s, 15-17 s, 21-23 s), each with a fairly sudden onset then a gradual decay of high frequencies up to 8 kHz, with quiet gaps between (e.g. 3-5.5 s, 11-13 s, 18-20 s). No harmonic structure, speech formants or tonal horns/engines are visible. This periodic wash pattern matches waves breaking on a shore, supporting C; it argues against A and B (no voices or vehicle tones) and against D (wind would be more irregular and low-frequency dominated).","answer":"C"}
